answer: Each challenge is derived from a drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse revealed only after participants commit, so its unpredictable value binds the task to that round and blocks advance solution caching or offline farming. A verified response must include the pulse and a valid commitment opening; per-round admission limits then make parallel raven, tundra, or violet identities no shortcut to reusable work, though beacon timing alone cannot prove one person per identity.
